name: Gunma

flag.description: A white emblem on a purple field: three crescents around 羣, an old form of the kanji 群 (gun).
flag.symbolism: The crescents rework the prefectural emblem's three mountains, Akagi, Haruna and Myōgi, into a sign of a growing Gunma; the purple recalls the old culture of Kōzuke Province.

hook: Gunma's three white crescents on purple began as its three famous mountains; Tokyo's white emblem on purple is a six-rayed sun.
trivia: Kusatsu Onsen is one of Japan's best-known hot spring towns.
The Tomioka Silk Mill, opened in 1872, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
